verdict.rationale: GitLab stores code in Git, an open and portable format. It can also be self-hosted (Linux package, Docker, self-compile), and community users note its open-source core lets anyone run or fork their own instance. Together that gives a thin basis for taking code and leaving, but the pack documents no first-party export feature covering issues, merge requests, CI and other data. The REST API/OpenAPI spec is only a building block for building one, and gitlab-comm-3 describes importing into GitLab, not exporting out. Missing for 10: a documented project/group export feature, coverage of non-repository data (issues, MRs, wikis, CI metadata), stated open export formats, and hands-on evidence of a successful full exit.
